title: God’s Promises Require Action
verse: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath—a total of 14 cities and their towns. This was the land assigned to the tribe of Benjamin by its clans.
observation: This chapter is full of God’s open doors. The goal is to take each one of them and move forward.
application: When God opens a door, move forward.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us take action when it is time.
